name: polymarket-copy-bot
description: Mirrors a target Polymarket wallet's BUY trades to your own account with configurable sizing and risk controls.

comments.overrides: Forces a patched ws across the tree. @ethersproject/providers v5, pulled in by @polymarket/clob-client-v2, otherwise resolves ws@8.18.0, which has a known uninitialized-memory-disclosure advisory. Same major version, so this is a safe pin. Revisit once the client drops its ethers v5 dependency.
